title: post-merge: UI test binaries abort (exit -1, 0-2 s) when gates run in parallel on one host

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Since PR #3185, the post-merge gate runs one independent run for each merge commit. Several gates now run at the same time. Three runs failed with the same signature: a UI test binary stops in 0-2 s with `exit -1`. The log shows no test output, no panic and no assert. Later runs of the same code pass the same step.

| Run | Commit | Runner | Red step | Gate job time (UTC) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 44948384882 | 273642212 | skull | `ui suites: lib` | 20:50-22:15 |
| 44950073227 | 6ffa808ae | egg | `ui suites: trace_parity` | 21:09-22:08 |
| 44955923206 | ced4dc34e | wopr | `ui suites: egui_app` | 22:16-22:38 |

Evidence from the jobs API:
- wopr and wopr-2 look like two runners on one host. The red run on wopr (22:16-22:38) overlapped the run on wopr-2 for a0fe9f1dc (22:07-22:33).
- The host of skull, egg, len-pm, dude and cheese is not known from the API.
- The same steps passed on uma, wopr-2, dude and cheese, and in the later runs on c59aa0730 and a0fe9f1dc.

Hypothesis: two UI test binaries on one host use one shared resource at the same time. Possible resources are the GPU or wgpu adapter, the display session, a fixed port or a shared temp directory.

Candidate fixes:
1. Serialize the UI suites on one host: one concurrency group for each host, or a host lock around the UI suites steps.
2. Find the shared resource and give each run its own copy.

This is not on the cut list of v0.25.0. The release gate runs on `cut.yml`; it uses a re-run of the failed step for this signature.
